title: `merge --review-record` posts the review record itself, so no lane posts it by hand
why: Coordinator 13:12 CST Nov 8: `merge --review-record` prints the record and a lane posts it by hand. Lane session_013NEJKzXyKNARtJsbz3Q1R2 added prose after the CI line on three posts (#1755, #2032), which parse_review rejects at batch time. Fix the cause: the tool posts the comment itself, so no hand step is left. This covers the lane's proposed record-post-shape-check; review-record-parse-warn and review-record-post-check stay as the read-side checks.
note: Parked (coordinator 13:13 CST Nov 8): #1706 (open, head 85de59e54) already refuses a record body at post time that does not parse, which is the harm this step targets. Reopen only if a malformed record gets posted after #1706 merges (rule building-guard-needs-incident). Incident (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, its own mistake, 16:48 CST Nov 8; it asked for step record-print-then-post, folded here): it ran `merge --review-record ... > rec.md; printf footer >> rec.md; gh api .../comments -F body=@rec.md`. The record print refused (rc 2), but `;` still ran the post with a body that held only the footer. The content filter emptied the body, so nothing was posted. Interim guard it proposed: check-tail, or a sibling rule, refuses `;` or a newline between a `--review-record` print and the post, and requires `&&`. A tool that posts the record itself removes the hand chain. Sighting (coordinator 17:56 CST Nov 8): lane builder-diff-auto-merge-reflog hand-wrote a review record with prose lines on #2322, and the merge tool's write path did not stop it. Sighting (coordinator 17:58 CST Nov 8): q_max #1149's record (lane session_013NEJL3FMWkL99pPeoTjyH2, head 915b5f4ba) has a Note paragraph after the CI line and does not parse; runner 9 asked for a repost. Third malformed hand-post on Nov 8 (#2322, q_max #1149, and the #1755/#2032 lane). Triage read of #1706 (review-record-post-parses), 18:01 CST: its guard is the installed hooks guard, so it judges `gh pr comment`, `gh issue comment` and the shell PATCH in any repo, q_max included; but it is a draft, dirty, stacked on the MCP stack (#1601), and its MCP edit branch moved to a later PR, so a post through the GitHub MCP tool is not judged. Triage reading: routing this step now removes the hand post at its cause. Routed by the coordinator 18:00 CST Nov 8 (unparked). Related, filed separately 18:43 CST Nov 8: step docs-only-record-checks-diff (the docs-only kind is not checked against the diff); this lane may fold it in. Note, not a fold (coordinator 19:35 CST Nov 8): the tool already refuses a --head that differs from the live PR head (merge/merge.py:3626 on main, checked by triage); degen #546's wrong sha came from a hand-typed post, the path this step removes. Sighting (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85, 22:30 CST Nov 8): notes between the `CI:` line and `---` made the newest record on #1975, #1717, #1998 and #2025 unparseable, and again on #1666 at 22:20 CST; `merge --review-record --fix-check` refused on #1998 and #2025. The lane reposted clean records with notes after `---`. Correction (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, measured 22:40 CST Nov 8): a note after `---` is not safe either. GitHub's footer filter moves the attribution footer to the end, so text after it lands above it and the parser rejects the record. A record comment holds only the tool's print plus the footer. Also: on #1666, #1717, #1998 and #2025 the newest parseable record was old, so `merge --review-record --fix-check` refused; the lane posted records from the tool's print plus a `Fix check:` line, and review_state reads all four as done. When the tool posts records itself, it should also accept a fix check after an unparseable newest record. The edited-record check moved to step record-edit-refused (coordinator 23:14 CST Nov 8; this lane's PR already holds a round-3 record). Sightings (lane scratchpad-file-ownership, 23:19 CST Nov 8; folded here instead of a new step review-record-text-below-rule): records on #2023 and #2296 held free text above `---`, so the merge tool could not read them; runner 8 dropped #2023 from batch 66 for it. Sighting (lane notes-fix-large-1, session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m, 03:05 CST Nov 9; it proposed step record-head-from-remote, folded here): a review record on #2402 carried a hand-typed Head sha (3e8d2f4904b5...) instead of the branch tip (3e8d2f490060...); the lane fixed it in place (comment 6736241688). When the tool posts, it reads the head itself from `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/<branch>` and refuses a head that is not the branch tip, so no session types a sha. Step round-line-names-head covers the Round lines' heads. #2355 is to be replaced by a PR from branch record-tool-posts-itself-b, because commit cce2ab6d7 has no Red-run trailer (coordinator 04:09 CST Nov 9). Sighting (lane notes-fix-page, session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8, 04:17 CST Nov 9; proposed as step record-notes-file, folded here): four records (#2110, #2375, #2383, #2399) held notes between the CI line and `---`, so parse_review read them as bad; nothing refused them at post time, and runner 8 held three as handed off; the lane reposted them. When the tool posts, it takes notes (for example `--notes-file`) and puts them after `---`, or it parses its own output with the notes added before it posts. #2413 replaces #2355: release check passed at 54815be7a, net value zero, on the batch 69 list (coordinator 04:23 CST Nov 9). Notes (same source): (1) the comment-post route from a cloud session has no row in hooks/route_rows.json; measured: comments 6729782146 and 6737644286 posted from the cloud. (2) guard_stream refuses `merge --review-record ... --confirm | tail` as a long wait, and a local session has no `merge * --confirm` allow rule. Sighting (lane verdict-format-line session_013NEJL1BCgLVUACYU5ujv9A, 04:31 CST Nov 9): #1913 comment 6737460748 (04:12 CST) had findings above its `---` line, so parse_review read it as malformed with no warning at post time; the next `--fix-check` was refused with the misleading "must be the Head of the newest earlier review record". Fixed by hand at 04:28 CST. The lane named a step record-post-parse-check, which does not exist; this step (the tool posts, so no hand text) and #1706 (post-time parse guard, step review-record-post-parses) cover it. Sighting (coordinator, 05:18 CST Nov 9): the #2412 lane edited its first review record comment once, to remove a note that broke the parser; the newest record is clean. Sighting (lane revive-1042, 14:40 CST Nov 9): the GitHub MCP server moves the attribution footer to the end of a comment body, so notes written below `---` land inside the review record and `merge --reviewed` reads it as bad; #2123's record comment 6750855406, fixed by hand. The lane's candidate step review-record-post-parse folds here and into review-record-post-parses. Fact (lane revive-1042 via the coordinator, 14:40 CST Nov 9): an edited review record blocks release (updated_at != created_at). #2123's record 6750855406 was edited to repair a moved footer, so the coordinator refused it; a fresh round 3 runs at 2c7abc067. So a hand repair of a posted record costs a whole review round. Debt verdict-hides-review-record points here (02:12 CST Nov 10): two hand-typed records tonight (#2414 after verdict hid the lines; #2378 with an added blank line, which failed parse). #2413 re-released to batch 72 at 08:39 CST Nov 10 (coordinator).
